alt: 春末河岸的櫻花已大多凋謝，花瓣散落步道並漂流在水面上，母子隔著護欄靜靜觀賞。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 落花流水 describes the scattered, fading scene at late spring, and can also mean a defeated scattered condition. Show a quiet modern city riverbank after a passing spring breeze: many pink blossoms have fallen from a mostly bare flowering branch and drift scattered downstream on flowing water; a few petals lie across the path, while fresh green leaves are just emerging. A child and parent calmly observe from a safe walkway, seeing the season change. Clearly show both fallen blossoms and moving water, with gentle wistful mood, not a disaster or littered urban scene. Natural anatomy, safe distance from water, believable reflections and current, no extra limbs or text.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary riverside park at the end of spring. Delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor, colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper; restrained natural colors, no 3D.
